Vina 1.2.7's strict PDBQT parser rejects the chemotype atype 'Pt'; the run_pocket_sweep probe path transparently falls back to 'Mg' for every pocket (chemotype_atype_accepted=False across all 10). Chemotype kcal/mol is therefore bit-identical to Wf-121 P3 baseline (delta_vs_ex8_mg = 0.000 kcal/mol per pocket; aggregate_chemotype_mean = -3.1552 kcal/mol; baseline_mean_actual = -3.1552 kcal/mol from Wf-121 sweep_summary.json; delta_vs_wf121_baseline_minus_3p103 = -0.0522 kcal/mol which is the task-stated baseline comparison NOT the actual baseline). NOT a regression, but also NOT the expected +0.5 to +1.5 kcal/mol lift from TODO-128. The Wf-143 Stage 2 d-block VDW table is correctly populated (Pt r=1.75 A, epsilon=0.080 kcal/mol from Bondi 1964 + UFF Rappe 1992), but Vina 1.2.7's hardcoded atom-type table does not consume these — VDW inject mechanism wired + probe fallback documented for when Vina does gain these atypes (R20 GPU TODO-128 Phase 2 or AD4 proper switch). n_pockets_pass_target_minus5=0, n_pockets_pass_stretch_minus6=0, n_pockets_pass_cutoff_minus7=0 — none of the 10 pockets reach the covalent-binder affinity floor.
